config.label: 0x-prefixed 32-byte hex private key that funds USDC payments on EVM chains (Base, Arbitrum, …)
config.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte hex private key that funds USDC payments on EVM chains (Base, Arbitrum, …). At least one of the EVM/SVM keys is required. Treat like cash — use a dedicated low-balance wallet.

config.label: Solana secret key that funds USDC payments: base58 64-byte secret key (Phantom / solana-keygen format) or a JSON array of 64 integers
config.description: Solana secret key that funds USDC payments: base58 64-byte secret key (Phantom / solana-keygen format) or a JSON array of 64 integers. At least one of the EVM/SVM keys is required. Treat like cash.

config.label: Per-call spending cap in atomic units (USDC has 6 decimals)
config.description: Per-call spending cap in atomic units (USDC has 6 decimals). Payments above this abort with a clear reason.

config.label: Cumulative session spending ceiling in atomic units
config.description: Cumulative session spending ceiling in atomic units. Once total spend would exceed it, further payments abort until restart.

config.label: Comma-separated payee allowlist
config.description: Comma-separated payee allowlist. When set, any payment whose payTo address is not listed is refused.

config.label: Comma-separated hostname allowlist for outbound paid requests
config.description: Comma-separated hostname allowlist for outbound paid requests. When set, any other host is refused before a request is signed.

config.label: Set to 1 to allow http:// targets (local development only)
config.description: Set to 1 to allow http:// targets (local development only). https is enforced otherwise.

config.label: Max number of x402 Bazaar resources to register as dynamic tools at startup
config.description: Max number of x402 Bazaar resources to register as dynamic tools at startup. Set 0 to disable discovery.

config.label: x402 Bazaar discovery endpoint
config.description: x402 Bazaar discovery endpoint. Override to point at a self-hosted or alternative bazaar.

config.label: How many request-amounts to deposit at once when opening an EVM batch-settlement channel
config.description: How many request-amounts to deposit at once when opening an EVM batch-settlement channel.

config.label: Hard cap in atomic units on a single batch-settlement channel deposit or top-up
config.description: Hard cap in atomic units on a single batch-settlement channel deposit or top-up.

config.label: Directory for persisted batch-settlement channel state (survives client restarts)
config.description: Directory for persisted batch-settlement channel state (survives client restarts).

config.label: Per-chain RPC override, one variable per chain id (RPC_URL_<chainId>, e
config.description: Per-chain RPC override, one variable per chain id (RPC_URL_<chainId>, e.g. RPC_URL_8453 for Base). Defaults to viem's public RPC for that chain.
